name: grugops-capture-target
description: The runnable fixture project the Phase 33 live capture installs grugops onto (D-03). Every gate command the section-14 workflow names exists here and exits 0, so emit-verdict is reachable in the target. Deliberately no TypeScript: tsconfig.json compiles scripts/**/*.ts and a fixture .ts would demand a committed .js twin. The source file is .mjs rather than .js because scripts/freshness.ts treats every committed .js under scripts/ as a build output.
